objective: Strengthen the manuscript from methodological infrastructure with philosophical implications into a direct argument about when structural comparison warrants cognitive-capacity individuation.
central_thesis: Structural comparison can bear evidential weight in cognitive-capacity individuation only when its comparison representation, preservation criterion, and granularity are both specified and independently warranted for the identity claim at issue.

distinction.specification_transparency: The representation, preservation criterion, and granularity must be explicit and inspectable.
distinction.independent_epistemic_warrant: When comparison results are used to support a capacity-identity claim, there must be a reason beyond reconstruction success itself for treating the preserved structure as identity-relevant.

dialectical_targets.beni_task: Reconstruct strongest relevant Beni argument; accept heterogeneous-theory structural unification and exposed invariances, then identify the additional warrant needed before preserved structure is treated as kind-/capacity-constitutive. Do not reject PP/FEP.
dialectical_targets.north_task: Treat objective perspicuity as a possible way to discharge the warrant burden; do not claim the working basis is perspicuous.
dialectical_targets.brousalis_task: Use justified comparison dimensions as the condition under which similarity becomes epistemically relevant.
dialectical_targets.kohar_task: Use as a model of concrete cognitive-science dialectic, not as a forced ally.

capacity_cases.required_conclusion: label-only identity inference insufficient; unified semantic-memory capacity OPEN; preservation debt incurred
label difference does not establish non-identity; shared substructure is evidence of reusable organization; one shared substructure does not establish whole-capacity identity

capacity_cases.selection_rule: frozen pair with zero fine working-basis bounded overlap and positive CPCG overlap; selected from already-certified CPCG collisions before manuscript rewrite
capacity_cases.required_conclusion: coarse overlap is representation-sensitive and does not by itself settle capacity identity

comparator_positive_controls.purpose: show comparator reachability, not validate a taxonomy
required: same claim with identifier/presentation renaming -> EQUIVALENT
one authorized added structural distinction -> RIGHT_STRICT_REFINEMENT_OF_LEFT

human_validation.sampling: one source from each of 8 primary strata plus 2 challenge cases, deterministically SHA256-ranked from exact M12 parent
human_validation.independent_human_requirement: A real independent human begins from original sources and constructs structured claim records independently, without access to frozen ClaimIR/adjudication/answer keys during extraction.

mandatory_limitation: Procedural auditability is established; inter-rater reliability remains unmeasured.
prohibited_claims: semantic memory is definitely multiple capacities
ATT01 and BLF01 are the same capacity
